title: Turn review into durable revision
summary: When review shows that a rule, article or classification overclaims, change the smallest responsible object, version/record the correction, add a regression when mechanical, and preserve why the lesson exists.
invariants: Do not erase the lineage of a material correction.
Do not bulk-rewrite unrelated sphere objects to make one correction.
Automatic fixes require a stronger evidential bar than suggested corrections.
A precise, grounded review is a lesson source, not a disagreement to dismiss.
Encode the better model explicitly and add a regression assertion where the correction is mechanical.
Version material changes and re-qualify the delivered artifact.
